I am a PhD candidate at Ben Gurion University of the Negev where I research multi-agent turn-taking under the supervision of Dr. Eliya Nachmani. My work sits at the intersection of generative AI, diffusion models, and deep learning, with a focus on audio and language applications.

Previously I was a Senior AI Engineer at General Motors Cyber Security Group, where I developed deep learning models for audio-based event detection and integrated LLMs to build autonomous AI agents. I received my M.Sc. from Bar Ilan University in 2026, advised by Prof. Sharon Gannot, and my B.Sc. from the Technion in 2022.
